pages.title: Charminar
pages.extract: Charminar is a monument and mosque located in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It was constructed in 1591. The landmark is the symbol of the city.

pages.title: Laad Bazaar
pages.extract: Laad Bazaar is a market near the Charminar. It is known for bangles.

pages.title: Mecca Masjid, Hyderabad
pages.extract: The Mecca Masjid is a mosque in Hyderabad. It is one of the oldest and largest mosques in India.

pages.title: Mir Mahboob Ali Khan, Asaf Jah VI
pages.extract: Mir Mahboob Ali Khan was the sixth Nizam of Hyderabad State.
